title: North Dakota Century Code Chapter 34-03 - Termination of Employment
verified_how: fetched the register's Title 34 chapter index (https://ndlegis.gov/cencode/t34.html): chapter row '34-03' with name 'Termination of Employment', no '[Repealed]' marker; then fetched https://ndlegis.gov/cencode/t34c03.html, which lists sections from 34-03-01. Currency: 07/01/25 update, 69th Legislative Assembly.
notes: North Dakota is an at-will state and this chapter sets the notice and termination rules for employment for a specified and unspecified term rather than a severance-pay entitlement. There is no state severance-pay or mass-layoff-notice statute; collective redundancy notice is federal (WARN Act, 29 U.S.C. ch. 23).
